turn.text:
Turn on antivirus using the signature database and block known malware in HTTP downloads for the user zone.

Site notes: R1 is the firewall `fw`; the user zone is 192.168.10.0/24 (eth1). The signature engine is Suricata (NFQUEUE/IPS capable), its rules live in /etc/suricata/rules/local.rules, and the EICAR test file is served at http://198.51.100.10/eicar.txt (and over HTTPS). The device has no systemd: start daemons directly. Put malware blocking inline for the user zone's HTTP downloads.
Plan: echo 'drop http any any -> any any (msg:"EICAR"; content:"EICAR-STANDARD-ANTIVIRUS-TEST-FILE"; sid:1000001; rev:1;)' > /etc/suricata/rules/local.rules; mkdir -p /var/log/suricata; nohup suricata -q 0 -S /etc/suricata/rules/local.rules -l /var/log/suricata >/var/log/suricata/run.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 30); do grep -q 'Engine started' /var/log/suricata/suricata.log 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done; nft insert rule inet filter forward ip saddr 192.168.10.0/24 queue num 0 bypass; nft insert rule inet filter forward ip daddr 192.168.10.0/24 queue num 0 bypass
